# Inputs/Validation directive

Composes consumer validators and presents an Angular control's errors.

## Identity

- Class: `ValidationDirective`
- Selector: `[dlValidation]`
- Kind: standalone directive
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/inputs/validation.directive.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/inputs/validation.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone ValidationDirective from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

## Public instance state and methods


- `focus(value: boolean): void`
- `leave(event: FocusEvent): void`
- `escape(): void`

Methods include event handlers; use consumer-facing methods demonstrated by the stories. Angular form lifecycle hooks are managed by Angular.

## Related data types

```ts
export type ValidationMessageResolver =
  | string
  | ((details: unknown, control: AbstractControl) => string);

export type ValidationMessages = Record<string, ValidationMessageResolver>;

export interface ValidationState {
  errors: ValidationErrors | null;
  messages: string[];
  visible: boolean;
  pending: boolean;
}
```

## Storybook defaults

```ts
{
    dlValidation: true,
    validationDisplay: "popover",
    validationWhen: "always",
    validators: [companyEmail, Validators.minLength(8)],
    validationMessages: {
      companyEmail: "Use your @example.com work email.",
      minlength: "Enter at least eight characters.",
    },
  }
```

```ts

```

```ts
(args) => ({
    props: {
      ...args,
      control: new FormControl("hello", {
        nonNullable: true,
        validators: [Validators.required],
      }),
    },
    template: `<div style="width:360px;max-width:100%;min-height:300px"><dl-input id="validation-email" label="Work email" hint="Your work account email." [formControl]="control" ${argsToTemplate(args)}/><button dlButton variant="secondary" style="margin-top:170px" (click)="control.reset('')">Reset</button><p>Form status: <output>{{control.status}}</output></p></div>`,
  })
```
